question: How can you remove the defect of vision presbyopia?
text:
Presbyopia can be **corrected with reading glasses**. Their positive-power (convex) lenses help you focus on nearby objects. If you also need glasses for distance, **bifocals or progressive lenses** can correct both near and distance vision in the same pair. Multifocal contact lenses are another option. ([nei.nih.gov](https://www.nei.nih.gov/eye-health-information/eye-conditions-and-diseases/presbyopia?utm_source=openai))

These options compensate for the age-related loss of flexibility in the eye’s natural lens; they don’t reverse it. An eye exam can confirm presbyopia and determine the right lens strength. ([nei.nih.gov](https://www.nei.nih.gov/eye-health-information/eye-conditions-and-diseases/presbyopia?utm_source=openai))
